text_block_list.text:
Seeing how exhausted Matikane Fukukitaru 
was, I decided to take her to the 
infirmary to rest.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
*Salute!* Leave it to me! Resting is my 
second-best skill right after 
fortune-telling!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yes! Well then, good niiight!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ngh? Where is...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This mystical aura... this must have 
something to do with Lady Shiraoki! What 
business might you have with me, I 
wonder?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Huh!? S-Something just fell!! This is...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Whoa! It's a "Do Your Best Daruma"!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Takes me back... Shiraoki-sama gave this 
to me in a dream, didn't she?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"And so, even if I came in dead last in 
the footrace, I felt motivated to keep 
trying my best..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I've started to care a little less about 
whether Big Sis wins, too! Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I did nothing but cry, but... 
Now, I'm facing forward and running.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Keep running and the path will open!" 
...Just like the words I was given back 
then!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hanya...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I had such a nostalgic dream. This 
is definitely, absolutely an auspicious 
omen!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mun! Full of energy! Lady Shiraoki, I'm 
gonna keep on running!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wait, isn't this the test I failed the 
other day?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It was so disastrous that I secretly gave 
it a ritual burning, and yet...!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Take this, and this!! Rest in peace! Rest 
in peace!! Seiyaaa--!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Pugya!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... What an awful nightmare that 
was...

Unable to get the dream out of her head, 
Matikane Fukukitaru was unable to get 
enough rest.
